title: Gateway to the Savage Frontier

unmodified_party_control.description: The same genuine tavern route reached the tactical board with three Zhentil Fighters, then the ordinary party lost. This control establishes the encounter without depending on the deterministic-victory character patch.

milestones.claim: The native descriptor-18 prompt shows WHAT'LL IT BE? with FIGHT and LEAVE.
FIGHT enters the native tactical board with a Zhentil Fighter roster.
The isolated deterministic-victory party acts on the authentic board and kills the native enemy.
The original engine reports tavern-combat victory and awards 143 XP per character.
Retail ECL resumes at 9,9 north and redispatches descriptor 17's Auld Macdon tavern sign.
The legal continuation reaches descriptor 122's collapsed-ceiling scene.
Descriptor 122 enters the native tactical board with Griffons.
The original engine reports Griffon-combat victory and awards 2397 XP per character.
The live native process resumes exploration at 6,14 south.
A cold original-DOS reload is silent at 6,14 south; the Griffon event does not reopen.

automation.authoritative_evidence: retail ECL/GEO/OVR bytes, exact routes, framebuffer hashes, saved bytes, cold reload, and automated tests

claim_boundary: The deterministic-victory helper modifies only isolated 422-byte CHRDAT sidecars after preserving originals and emitting a hash manifest. It does not modify SAVGAM, ECL, GEO, MON, GAME.EXE, or GAME.OVR. The unmodified-party control independently proves authentic encounter and tactical entry; the patched party makes victory/resume capture deterministic. Build screenshots and retail save bytes remain ignored local evidence and are not redistributed.
